headline: WordPress Cost India 2026
description: How much does a WordPress website cost in India in 2026? Real market pricing by project type, plus a free interactive calculator to estimate your own.

itemListElement.name: WordPress Website Cost in India (2026): Real Numbers + Free Calculator

mainEntity.name: How much does a basic WordPress website cost in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: A basic 5–10 page business website with a theme-based design typically runs ₹30,000–₹80,000 in 2026, including a contact form and basic on-page SEO setup.

mainEntity.name: How much does a WooCommerce online store cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A store with up to 50 products, one payment gateway and basic shipping configuration typically costs ₹1,00,000–₹2,00,000. Larger catalogues, multiple gateways or custom features push this higher.

mainEntity.name: Is a freelancer cheaper than an agency for WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes on paper — freelancer quotes often run ₹15,000–₹70,000. The trade-off is availability, accountability and what happens if that one person is unavailable when something breaks.

mainEntity.name: What ongoing costs should I budget beyond the build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domain (₹800–₹2,500/year), hosting (₹2,000–₹15,000/month), any premium licenses, and either your own time or a maintenance plan for updates, backups and security.

mainEntity.name: Can you give me a fixed price instead of a range?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — that's exactly what a free call gets you. Use the calculator to frame your budget, then book a call for a fixed-price proposal within 48 hours.
